reasoning_chain: Multiple callers (frontend, checkoutservice, recommendationservice) show slow calls converging on productcatalogservice.
productcatalogservice's own p95 latency is low (0.48ms), indicating it is not slow processing requests but requests queue before CPU.
CPU usage of productcatalogservice is 46% of its limit, which is low, but the CPU limit was recently reduced drastically from 200m to 10m, likely causing CPU throttling and queuing.

Slow edges from checkoutservice->productcatalogservice (45.16ms), frontend->productcatalogservice (24.01ms), and recommendationservice->productcatalogservice (30.94ms) confirm productcatalogservice is the bottleneck.
Frontend->checkoutservice is also slow (130.24ms) but checkoutservice's own p95 is high (493.75ms) and its CPU usage is 0%, indicating it queues waiting for productcatalogservice.
No errors are observed, so this is a latency/resource exhaustion issue, not a crash or error propagation.
